svg.title: Ordinary demand, Hicks compensation, and old-basket compensation
svg.desc: Synthetic teaching cases. Left: xy preferences, old prices 1 and 1, budget 10; new prices 4 and 1. A=(5,5), M=(1.25,5), H=(2.5,10), S=(3.125,12.5). H costs 20; the old basket costs 25. Right: linear preferences 2x+y, same prices and initial budget. Choices move between axes; target utility 20 costs 20 at new prices.
svg.text: Synthetic data; quantity in portions, prices in currency / portion
Right dotted blue: old indifference line 2x + y = 20.
